SCGSim owns the reusable geometry, solver preparation, handoff, result and
report APIs. [OrPen SC PDK](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/orpen-sc-pdk) owns public
component geometry, material/stack facts and executable component notebooks.
A Python script or notebook can call SCGSim; no parent workspace is required.

The site uses native Askr presentation. Overview introduces the package,
Tutorial walks through calculations, Concept explains the models, and Contract
provides exact interface references. Existing document URLs remain available.

Repository layout, implementation responsibilities, documentation builds and
release procedures belong to the secondary
[maintainer entry](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/scgsim/blob/develop/MAINTAINING.md).

## SCGSim 2.0 ownership candidate — CONVERGING

The v2 module and API structure is implemented as a current source candidate
and remains `CONVERGING`; source review, installed-package observations and
native behavior are separate from this layout. The intake baseline is
`develop@3a52fb1`, tree `96adcf8672b497a29dd0a6b43043cca11efc3043`. Existing
consumers remain on their recorded pins until they choose a migration.

| Target area | Owns | Must not take ownership of |
|---|---|---|
| `scgsim.geometry` | Source-facing component/occurrence and stack adaptation, GeometryPlan/snapshot, normalized inputs, vacuum/curve preparation and detached summaries | Compiler stage orchestration, Palace/AEDT physics or execution state |
| `scgsim.geometry.compiler` | Advanced builder, derived records, pipeline validators and construction dispatch | Component source ownership or solver state |
| `scgsim.geometry.models` and lower primitives | One canonical model/type definition and shared source/compiler primitives | Duplicate definitions, source-to-planning dependency cycles |
| `scgsim.semantics` | Stdlib-only immutable, revision-bound facts | Mutable backend objects, solver tags interpreted as source truth |
| `scgsim.palace.preparation` | Separate Electrostatic and Eigenmode setup objects, mutable state/invalidation, and shared preparation functions | A common Simulation base, Palace submission, or merged state owners |
| `scgsim.palace.mesh` | Route build, dynamic Gmsh worker, native mesh summaries, and offline mesh-quality reader | Result receipt custody or physical convergence judgments |
| `scgsim.palace.execution` | Manual handoff packages and standalone host receipt recording | Automatic solver submission or result interpretation |
| `scgsim.palace.results` | Returned artifact/custody validation, result data, and detached EPR | Solver execution or plotting state |
| `scgsim.palace.presentation` | Palace trust, physics and cost projections and report figures | A common cross-solver physical quantity model |
| `scgsim.aedt.specs` | Shared request primitives, HFSS/Q2D/Q3D-v3 records, and explicit parser dispatch | Runtime/Desktop state or Q3D input-v1/v2 |
| `scgsim.aedt.preparation` | Portable handoff, source-backed family preparation, canonical cohort membership | Desktop lifetime, mutable EigenmodeSim state, or solve results |
| `scgsim.aedt.runtime` | Sole transaction/receipt coordinator and one Desktop lifecycle; family-specific native prepare/solve/export/readback | Shared geometry source ownership or family-crossing physics |
| `scgsim.aedt.epr` | EPR source geometry, fields/cache, and analysis workflow | Desktop lifecycle or general result custody |
| `scgsim.aedt.results` | Strict run/EPR resolution, provenance readers, convergence and matrix observations | Solver execution or display state |
| `scgsim.aedt.presentation` | Display-only projections and plotting with lazy optional imports | Native calculations or result validation |
| `scgsim.visualization` | Backend-bound source/receipt loaders, detached scene/preview objects, and rendering | Solver state, simulation status or physical acceptance |
| `scgsim.presentation` | Shared, solver-physics-neutral notebook formatting | Domain projections or scientific calculations |

The baseline facade and direct-submodule symbol maps for geometry, AEDT, Palace
and visualization, with their implemented destinations, are in the
[API migration reference](api-migration.qmd).
Publicness comes from documented facades/contracts and declared exports, not
from whether a Python module happens to be importable. The v2 change
intentionally does not preserve `scgsim.sgb` compatibility wrappers or Q3D
input-v1/v2 paths; the public AEDT command `python -m scgsim.aedt.run` remains
a supported entry and delegates to the transaction owner.

State boundaries remain observable. Palace Electrostatic and Eigenmode
preparation retain separate mutable state and invalidation/failure ordering;
the Gmsh worker is a process boundary, and its mesh observer is not the offline
quality reader. AEDT `EigenmodeSim` retains mutable configuration and
invalidation state, while one transaction owns receipt transitions and Desktop
release precedence. Geometry snapshots remain detached; compiler records are
derived outputs, and backend tags remain observations rather than source
authority. Relocation must preserve these ownership and failure contracts.

The SCGSim Development Lead owns tracked source. A fixed worker may write only
its assigned paths under a bounded lease; shared facade, receipt and package
metadata paths have one writer at a time. The architecture and complete
submodule migration contract are recorded alongside the source candidate.
Native observations and solver-specific result interpretation remain
separately owned and must not be implied by a directory reorganization.
